cells.title: Let the plan-freeze guard allow staging an unchanged plan.md
cells.action: Fix GitHub issue(s) #149 #146 #142 (read them with `gh issue view <n>`). The Bash write guard treats `git add <path>/plan.md` (and add then commit) as an edit of a frozen plan.md. Staging does not change bytes: the guard must let a VCS add/commit of plan.md pass, in main and inside a feature worktree, while a real write (redirect, sed -i, Edit/Write tool) to a frozen plan.md stays refused. Red first: add a unit test that reproduces the reported behavior and watch it fail, then fix, then run verify. No code comments. One commit with the trailer `cell: swp-1`.

truths: git add of a frozen, unchanged plan.md is allowed by the plan-freeze guard
a real write to a frozen plan.md is still refused
key_links: issue #149 #146 #142 reproduces as a failing test before the fix
prohibitions: Do not weaken an existing assertion
Do not touch files outside this cell

cells.title: Accept leader-check artifacts that start with a changed path plus evidence
cells.action: Fix GitHub issue(s) #143 #138 (read them with `gh issue view <n>`). recordLeaderCheck compares the whole artifact string to each trace.files_changed path (leader_check.rs:272). Accept an artifact whose leading path token (up to the first whitespace, ' (' or ' —') equals a files_changed path, so evidence text may follow the path. Red first: add a unit test that reproduces the reported behavior and watch it fail, then fix, then run verify. No code comments. One commit with the trailer `cell: swp-2`.

truths: an artifact that starts with a files_changed path followed by evidence text is accepted
an artifact that names no files_changed path is still refused
key_links: issue #143 #138 reproduces as a failing test before the fix
prohibitions: Do not weaken an existing assertion
Do not touch files outside this cell

cells.title: Accept a bare --detached flag on worktree merge
cells.action: Fix GitHub issue(s) #137 (read them with `gh issue view <n>`). `bee worktree merge --id X --detached` is refused as an unsupported argument shape while `--detached true` works. Make the bare boolean flag parse as true, matching how other boolean flags parse. Red first: add a unit test that reproduces the reported behavior and watch it fail, then fix, then run verify. No code comments. One commit with the trailer `cell: swp-3`.

truths: bee worktree merge --detached with no value parses as detached=true
--detached true still works
key_links: issue #137 reproduces as a failing test before the fix
prohibitions: Do not weaken an existing assertion
Do not touch files outside this cell

cells.title: Hash the lane worktree plan.md at gate --merge approval
cells.action: Fix GitHub issue(s) #148 (read them with `gh issue view <n>`). bee gate --preview hashes the feature worktree's plan.md but approval (plan_packets.rs around lines 605 and 702) hashes the control-root copy, so approval refuses a fresh preview as stale. Resolve plan.md for approval the same way preview does (lane worktree_root when the lane has a granted worktree). Red first: add a unit test that reproduces the reported behavior and watch it fail, then fix, then run verify. No code comments. One commit with the trailer `cell: swp-4`.

truths: gate approval hashes the same plan.md path the preview hashed
a really changed plan.md still refuses as stale
key_links: issue #148 reproduces as a failing test before the fix
prohibitions: Do not weaken an existing assertion
Do not touch files outside this cell

cells.title: Mark the workflow record closed when bee close finishes a lane
cells.action: Fix GitHub issue(s) #140 (read them with `gh issue view <n>`). A green bee close on a lane feature sets the lane phase to idle (close.rs:3336) but leaves the workflow record status active. Close the workflow record as part of the terminal write, reusing close_workflow_records in verbs/state_group/workflows.rs. Red first: add a unit test that reproduces the reported behavior and watch it fail, then fix, then run verify. No code comments. One commit with the trailer `cell: swp-5`.

truths: after a green bee close on a lane, workflows list reports that feature with status closed
close on the default record keeps its present behavior
key_links: issue #140 reproduces as a failing test before the fix
prohibitions: Do not weaken an existing assertion
Do not touch files outside this cell

cells.title: Refresh the shared index after the temp-index commit recipe
cells.action: Fix GitHub issue(s) #144 (read them with `gh issue view <n>`). The concurrent-worker git guard prints a GIT_INDEX_FILE temp-index recipe (paths.rs) that advances HEAD without updating the shared index, so the next shared-index commit reverts sibling commits. Make the recipe end by refreshing the shared index for the committed paths, and let the guard allow that path-scoped refresh while workers are live. Red first: add a unit test that reproduces the reported behavior and watch it fail, then fix, then run verify. No code comments. One commit with the trailer `cell: swp-6`.

truths: the printed temp-index recipe refreshes the shared index for the committed paths
the guard allows the path-scoped index refresh while workers are live
key_links: issue #144 reproduces as a failing test before the fix
prohibitions: Do not weaken an existing assertion
Do not touch files outside this cell

cells.title: Do not read bee-written cell snapshots as a dirty worktree at merge
cells.action: Fix GitHub issue(s) #141 (read them with `gh issue view <n>`). bee cells add from main mirrors .bee/cells/<id>.json into a granted feature worktree where they are untracked, so worktree merge refuses WORKTREE_MERGE_WORKTREE_DIRTY (phases.rs:556) and no CLI verb removes them. Treat bee-written .bee/ store files as part of the bootstrapped store under decision D8a in the dirty check. Red first: add a unit test that reproduces the reported behavior and watch it fail, then fix, then run verify. No code comments. One commit with the trailer `cell: swp-7`.

truths: untracked .bee/cells snapshots alone do not make worktree merge refuse as dirty
a real untracked product file still makes it refuse
key_links: issue #141 reproduces as a failing test before the fix
prohibitions: Do not weaken an existing assertion
Do not touch files outside this cell

cells.title: Resolve the implicit lane the same way for plan-conflicts derive and its lock
cells.action: Fix GitHub issue(s) #139 (read them with `gh issue view <n>`). plan-conflicts derive without --lane from a session bound to a lane resolves the workflow id from a stale binding while the lock resolves the live lane record, so it refuses 'workflow changed' on every retry (plan_conflicts.rs:523). Resolve both from the same live lane record. Red first: add a unit test that reproduces the reported behavior and watch it fail, then fix, then run verify. No code comments. One commit with the trailer `cell: swp-8`.

truths: plan-conflicts derive with an implicit lane succeeds when the binding names a live lane
a real workflow change during the call still refuses
key_links: issue #139 reproduces as a failing test before the fix
prohibitions: Do not weaken an existing assertion
Do not touch files outside this cell

cells.title: Add an attach alias for state session bind and print it in FIX lines
cells.action: Fix GitHub issue(s) #147 (read them with `gh issue view <n>`). The host worktree guard refuses any shell text holding the word for the session binding verb. Add `bee state session attach` as an alias of that verb (same flags, same effect), list it in the catalog, and make every FIX line bee prints name `attach`. Red first: add a unit test that reproduces the reported behavior and watch it fail, then fix, then run verify. No code comments. One commit with the trailer `cell: swp-9`.

truths: bee state session attach --lane X --session-id Y does what the old binding verb does
FIX lines name state session attach
key_links: issue #147 reproduces as a failing test before the fix
prohibitions: Do not weaken an existing assertion
Do not touch files outside this cell
